the conserved Trp residue in the WpD flexible loop plays an essential role in positioning the general acid/base for proton transfer.
Trp354 plays a role in align Arg409 for oxyanon binding and in positioning Asp356 for proton transfer.
Trp354 of the Yersinial PTPase plays a role in the catalysis and that this role is related to its positioning of Asp356 in the active site.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of Trp354 in the catalysis and regulation of Yersinia protein PTPase.
the role of Trp354 in the YPTPase catalytic mechanism and provides the basis for a more complete understanding of the catalytic function of the WpD flexible loop.
the role of the WpD-loop in the YPTPase and suggests that the WpD- loop may be an important determinant of the specificity of the Yersiniae PTPase for phosphotyrosine.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the conserved Trp residue in the flexible surface loop plays a critical role in the catalysis by PTPases.
the strictly conserved tryptophs in the WpD loops of PTPases play a role in positioning the catalytic residues and in maintaining an active site conformation that is optimal for catalysis.
the Trp354 is involved in catalysis by stabilizing the WpD-loop and positioning Asp356 in the active site.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Trp354, in addition to being involved in the oxyanion binding and leaving group stabilization, also plays an important role in the positioning of the catalytic residues in YPTPase.
Trp354 plays a critical role in the catalytic mechanism of the PTPases.
Trp354 plays a dual role in the catalysis by stabilizing the WpD-loop in a conformation suitable for catalysis and positioning Arg409 for binding to the transition state.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Trp354 may serve as a molecular hinge that allows the WpD flexible loop to move in and out of the active site.
the WpD-loop is a flexible loop which is essential for the catalytic function of PTPases.
the W354F mutant is an excellent tool to study the role of Trp354 in the catalysis and that the W354A mutant is a good tool to study the effect of the WpD-loop conformation on the catalysis.
